Sessionboard clone · Brand exploration

Three theme directions on shadcn tokens

Same surfaces, same components, different skin — each direction is a complete shadcn/ui variable set (light and dark), so switching is a one-file swap. Status colors stay fixed across all three; only the brand voice changes.

Greenroom — the room where speakers wait. Stage green on warm paper neutrals, 8px radius. Calm and hospitable; reads “events,” not “devtool.” The furthest from stock shadcn, still nowhere near flashy. Note: accepted-green sits near the brand green — pills are tinted, buttons are solid, so they never collide.

Drop-in tokens

Each block is a complete globals.css variable set in shadcn/ui format — paste over the defaults and every component follows. The same files live in the repo at docs/themes/.

greenroom.css warm paper · stage green · 8px radius 
:root {
  --background: #FAFAF7;  --foreground: #1B211D;
  --card: #FFFFFF;        --card-foreground: #1B211D;
  --popover: #FFFFFF;     --popover-foreground: #1B211D;
  --primary: #1D6B4C;     --primary-foreground: #F5FBF7;
  --secondary: #EDF3EE;   --secondary-foreground: #1D4634;
  --muted: #F1F2EC;       --muted-foreground: #5B6560;
  --accent: #EAF2EB;      --accent-foreground: #1D4634;
  --destructive: #B3402F; --destructive-foreground: #FFF7F5;
  --border: #E3E5DC;      --input: #E3E5DC;  --ring: #1D6B4C;
  --radius: 0.5rem;
  /* status (shared across directions) */
  --status-pending: #7A4F01;   --status-pending-bg: #FCEFCB;
  --status-maybe: #4C3D99;     --status-maybe-bg: #EAE6FB;
  --status-accepted: #14603E;  --status-accepted-bg: #D9F0E2;
  --status-declined: #96362A;  --status-declined-bg: #FBE0DC;
  --status-withdrawn: #6B6B67; --status-withdrawn-bg: #ECECEA;
}
.dark {
  --background: #131714;  --foreground: #E7EAE5;
  --card: #1A201C;        --card-foreground: #E7EAE5;
  --popover: #1A201C;     --popover-foreground: #E7EAE5;
  --primary: #4CAF82;     --primary-foreground: #0B1F15;
  --secondary: #213028;   --secondary-foreground: #A7D4BC;
  --muted: #222923;       --muted-foreground: #93A096;
  --accent: #213028;      --accent-foreground: #A7D4BC;
  --destructive: #E06C55; --destructive-foreground: #1C0E0A;
  --border: #2A332D;      --input: #2A332D;  --ring: #4CAF82;
  --status-pending: #EFC25E;   --status-pending-bg: #3A2D0E;
  --status-maybe: #B4A8F2;     --status-maybe-bg: #2A2547;
  --status-accepted: #6BC796;  --status-accepted-bg: #11301F;
  --status-declined: #EE9384;  --status-declined-bg: #3A1712;
  --status-withdrawn: #9C9CA3; --status-withdrawn-bg: #26262A;

Typography stays system-stack (or Geist/Inter if we ship a font) in all three — the identity is carried by hue, temperature, and radius, so no direction gets in the way of data-dense screens. Session IDs (SESS-4) always render in mono with tabular numerals.
